criteria.description: validate() merges the UA's own validity flags from the inner control with the flags the element derives, rather than replacing them.
criteria.evidence: fixtures/elements-behaviour/src/sk-form-input.test.ts: '[SC-003] a merged UA validity flag blocks a real submit and carries a message — mount-time', '...a constraint attribute changed AFTER mount reaches the host validity — the read-before-write ordering fix', '...a `type` change and a `value` change in the SAME update validate against the NEW type — the probe-ordering fix', '...a UA flag with no required/customError still gets a non-empty message — the setValidity throw fix', '...badInput reaches the host — REAL typing only, never a property assignment', '...a bad-input control keeps the user's buffer, rather than being overwritten mid-edit'. mutations.json carries 12 SC-003 arms for this element (4 pre-existing at mission start; 8 added across two review folds — corrected count, a prior version of this row miscounted both the total and which arms were new). Pass-1 fold added 5: probe-ordering, null-vs-undefined, label-alone, whitespace-customError, bad-input-buffer. The operator ruling (research.md R9) added 1: the programmatic badInput divergence, tested by '[SC-003] a value the current type cannot represent blocks a real submit — the programmatic badInput divergence (operator ruling)' (type="date", value="2026-13-45"), '[SC-003] a comma-formatted number blocks a real submit — the programmatic badInput divergence (operator ruling)' (type="number", value="1,5"), and the negative '[SC-003] an unparseable-looking but non-sanitizing value reports typeMismatch, NOT the new divergence — proves the branch does not over-fire' (type="email", value="notanemail"). Pass-2 fold added 2 more, both fixing regressions the pass-1 fold itself introduced: the unconditional-`validate()` fix for a permanent-invalid lock when a user undoes a bad keystroke back to the identical prior value ('[SC-003] undoing a bad keystroke back to the IDENTICAL prior value still re-validates — the unconditional validate() fix', '[SC-003] an untouched-looking empty number field survives a mistype-and-undo — the user-visible shape of the same regression'), and the `.trim()`-gated divergence check fixing a false positive on pure-whitespace-sanitized values ('[SC-003] a value that sanitizes to empty ONLY because it is pure whitespace does not trigger the divergence — the `.trim()` fix').
criteria.verified_by: ci @ 33997808460 (a23a15e, pre-merge gate pass 2) + local verification (#180)
criteria.notes: DEVIATION, documented: tooLong/tooShort are named in this FR's text but are deliberately NOT in the merge list — research.md R2 finding 3 records why (they require maxlength/minlength, which this mission does not forward, so their mutation arms would be permanently inert). All five reachable UA flags (patternMismatch, rangeUnderflow, rangeOverflow, stepMismatch, typeMismatch) plus badInput are merged and covered. The value-authority fork the debugger lens raised (raw vs. sanitized value, and whether valueMissing should rebase on the sanitized string) is now RESOLVED by explicit operator ruling, not by implementer judgement: setFormValue stays raw (unchanged contract), a type-cannot-represent divergence is detected and blocks submission as a badInput analogue, and the sanitized-submission / sanitized-valueMissing options were explicitly declined as out of this mission's scope (see research.md R9 in full). The two pass-2 arms (unconditional validate(), the trim() gate) postdate the cited CI run (a23a15e) — verified locally only as of this row (full test-file run green, each fix's mutation confirmed red-first by hand) — pending the next CI run at the head this fold produces.

criteria.description: readonly matches platform semantics: the value IS submitted (setFormValue(this.value)), and the control is barred from constraint validation (setValidity({})) — same validation outcome as disabled, opposite submission outcome.
criteria.evidence: fixtures/elements-behaviour/src/sk-form-input.test.ts '[SC-002][SC-003] a readonly control still submits but is barred from constraint validation' and '[SC-003] readonly reaches the inner control but is NOT reflected on the host'. research.md R1 records the measured platform table (readonly barred from constraint validation on the attribute alone, both engines) that this design is built against.
criteria.verified_by: ci @ 33997808460 (a23a15e, pre-merge gate pass 2) + local verification (#180)
criteria.notes: readonly is deliberately unreflected (R1) — the property still reaches the inner control via the property binding in render(), matching the disabled precedent for the same SC-005-shaped mutation-observability reason.
